#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Removes only resources labelled com.docker.compose.project=commitproof (AGENTS.md §5); images kept.
set -u -o pipefail
L=label=com.docker.compose.project=commitproof
c=$(docker ps -aq --filter "$L"); echo "containers: $(echo $c | wc -w)"
[ -n "$c" ] && timeout 120 docker rm -f $c >/dev/null
n=$(docker network ls -q --filter "$L"); echo "networks: $(docker network ls --filter "$L" --format '{{.Name}}' | tr '\n' ' ')"
[ -n "$n" ] && timeout 60 docker network rm $n >/dev/null
v=$(docker volume ls -q --filter "$L"); echo "volumes: $(echo $v | tr '\n' ' ')"
[ -n "$v" ] && timeout 60 docker volume rm $v >/dev/null
echo "left: containers=$(docker ps -aq --filter "$L" | wc -l) networks=$(docker network ls -q --filter "$L" | wc -l) volumes=$(docker volume ls -q --filter "$L" | wc -l)"
